jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027/28 recruitment round (Law Society of NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program)
jobs.notes: The Law Society's published 2027 recruitment dates confirm applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, but two staggered closing dates are listed (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) depending on the employer, so a single closing date cannot be stated — eligibility is normally penultimate-year students.

jobs.notes: The QLS page publishes a separate graduate-program key-dates table for the 2027 cycle (priority graduate decisions in early August with open-market recruitment immediately afterwards), but the exact graduate open/close dates could not be read off the live page in this check, so they are left null rather than guessed; the QLD seasonal clerkship round for the same cycle has already closed (opened 13 July 2026, closed 7 August 2026, offers 7–8 October 2026).

jobs.employer: Uniform Clerkship Scheme (coordinated by Adelaide University Law Students' Association and Flinders Law Students' Association)
jobs.program: Summer Clerkship — next (2027) Uniform Clerkship Scheme round
jobs.notes: The live scheme page still displays the 2026 scheme (that round opened and closed mid-2026 — e.g. signatory HWL Ebsworth Adelaide ran 23 June to 17 July 2026), and no dates for the next round have yet been published, so opens/closes are null rather than a reused prior-year date.

The firm's own early careers page confirms a 2027 Hobart program is planned but states only that information will be posted on that page in future, and no open or close date has been published; the firm's Adelaide, Brisbane, Canberra, Darwin and Sydney rounds for the 2026/27 cycle have already closed.
